output.commit_title: fix(notifications): wait for session hydration before routing v2 deep links
output.summary: routeV2 now awaits whenHydrated() before reading the session, as routeV1 does.
output.rationale: A push tap right after launch reaches routeV2 before the persisted session is restored (~350 ms), so state.session is still undefined; waiting for hydration restores the ordering the router relies on.

args.old_text:
import { routeDeepLink } from "../src/notifications/router";
import { hydrate, resetSessionForTests, sessionStore, whenHydrated } from "../src/store/session";
args.new_text:
import { routeDeepLink } from "../src/notifications/router";
import { hydrate, resetSessionForTests } from "../src/store/session";
